QuestInfo.name: The Lost Letter of Commendation
QuestInfo.0: Power B. Fore has lost his precious letter of commendation. You'd better give him a hand at the training center.
QuestInfo.1: He says he's sure the monsters at the training center are guilty of stealing his precious letter. He wants you to get it back.
QuestInfo.2: You were able to retrieve Power B. Fore's precious letter of commendation and returned it to him.

0.0: What? No way! My letter! My letter! Where is it?! \r\n#b#L0#Hey... when's my training going to start?#l\n#k
0.1: Training? That's not important right now! Wait a sec... Hey, beginner! Here's your first training session! I want you to slay monsters in this area until you find my letter of commendation!\r\n#b#L0#What? That's my first training session?#l\n#k
0.2: Yes! Why? You don't want to do it?!

yes.0: Good! Then slay these monsters and find the letter of commendation. I'll keep looking for it around here, too.

no.0: If you're not going to help me, then stop bothering me!

1.0: Did you find it? Ohh, what a relief! Not bad for your first training session.\r\n#b#L0#This training session sounds like something you just randomly made up...#l\n#k
1.1: What? Who cares! Take a look at this letter! It shows...wait a minute, What's that on the letter?

yes.0: This letter should be kept spotless! The monsters stained my precious letter! Keep hunting them while I wipe the stains off my letter! My letter must be avenged! The training can't continue until then!

item.0: Hey, did you find it? I don't need a beginner like you slacking off on your first training session!
